keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms (e.g. your product name, a competitor, a topic). One search is billed per keyword.

includeComments.title: Include comment mentions
includeComments.description: Also match comments, not just submitted stories.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Only return posts/comments from within this many days of today.

maxResultsPerKeyword.title: Max results per keyword
maxResultsPerKeyword.description: Maximum number of matches to return per keyword, most recent first.
